title: NHS RTT 18-week standard
content_summary: Patients should start consultant-led treatment within 18 weeks of referral.

title: Long-waiter definition (52 weeks)
content_summary: Patients waiting 52+ weeks are reportable long waiters requiring active management.

title: Contact-failure threshold (90 days)
content_summary: No patient should go 90+ days without contact while on an active pathway.

title: High-risk composite criteria
content_summary: Risk rises with wait length, deprivation, referral severity, contact gap and pathway change.

title: Pathway-change reassessment rule
content_summary: A pathway change requires clinical reassessment; unactioned changes are a safety risk.

title: Referral severity stratification
content_summary: Two-week-wait and urgent referrals warrant lower breach thresholds than routine.

title: ONS patient-experience evidence
content_summary: 54% of waiting patients were never contacted; 45% rated experience poor or very poor.

title: Youth disengagement evidence
content_summary: 68% of 16-29s were never contacted, the worst-affected age band.

title: London borough deprivation context
content_summary: Inner-London boroughs concentrate IMD Q1 populations with higher anxiety scores.

title: Coordinator action menu
content_summary: Available actions: outreach call, letter, clinical escalation, booking review, no action.

title: Multilingual communication guidance
content_summary: Patients with a non-English primary language should receive translated communications.

title: Voice check-in suitability
content_summary: Voice outreach suits older, digitally-excluded or language-barrier patients.
